assumptions: Sleep logged: 23:15-09:00, ~9.75h — just above the 7-9h target band, a strong recovery night.

Eufy weigh-in at 10:00 logged to data/metrics/weight.json: 81.25 kg, BMI 27.7, body fat 27.2% (flagged extremely high by the app), body fat mass 22.00 kg, skeletal muscle mass 30.80 kg, visceral fat 11.0, muscle mass 56.20 kg, lean body mass 59.30 kg, bone mass 3.00 kg, protein 15.3% (flagged low), subcutaneous fat 23.9%, water 49.8%, BMR 1722 kcal, resting HR 62 bpm (back to standard/green), body age 29, body type Muscular Overweight (unchanged). vs. 17 Jul: weight -0.30 kg, body fat -0.1pp — both flat/slightly down, and resting HR dropped 17 bpm back to a normal range, confirming yesterday's 79 bpm reading was likely a short-sleep-related blip rather than a real trend. Cross-synced into data.js BODYWEIGHT and refreshed ATHLETE.bodyweightKg (81.55 → 81.25 kg).
10:25 watermelon, 300g — standard reference values, gave the day's first lycopene (~24.4mg vs 8mg target).

Lunch logged from description (no photo), time approximated at 13:30: 150g potatoes roasted in olive oil, 250g denis fish (sea bream) baked with butter, 0.7 of a large salad (whole recipe: 1 lettuce head, 30 cherry tomatoes, 0.5 large red onion, 150g drained baby mozzarella) dressed with the same homemade Maple-Balsamic Mustard Vinaigrette as 11 Jul (~25ml, reused from references/foods.json), plus a separate baked side of 0.5 large red onion (~85g) and 7 cherry tomatoes.

Fish reused the 11 Jul denis-fish per-100g rate (160kcal, 20g protein, 9g fat per 100g) since it's the same dish (baked with butter); potato-in-olive-oil is a new estimate (roasted potato base + ~10g absorbed oil, not weighed).
Salad recipe structure matches 11 Jul exactly except 30 cherry tomatoes (vs 35) and a 0.7 portion eaten (vs 0.75) — scaled from that day's per-ingredient math.

Fish and tomatoes are today's food-based micro drivers: ~500mg omega-3 and ~121mcg selenium + 200IU vitamin D from the 250g denis fish (same per-100g fish-micro rate implied by the 11 Jul day's totals); ~12.3mg lycopene + ~67mg vitamin C + ~72mcg folate DFE from today's cherry tomatoes (salad + baked side), on top of this morning's watermelon lycopene.

16:00 multivitamin (Thorne Basic Nutrients 2/Day, 2 caps): micros_sperm_priority raised by the verified supplement-fact values on top of the food-based totals (zinc +15mg, selenium +200mcg, folate +667mcg DFE, vitamin C +250mg, vitamin D +2000IU, vitamin E +16.5mg) — zero kcal/macros.
16:30 honeydew melon, 350g — same per-100g reference as the 11 Jul snack (35.8kcal/100g).
status_note: Slept ~9.75h (23:15-09:00) — a very long, solid night, just above the 7-9h target band. Weigh-in: 81.25 kg (-0.30 kg vs 17 Jul), body fat 27.2%, resting HR back down to 62 bpm (confirms yesterday's 79 bpm was a short-sleep blip). Double espresso at 10:10, a big lunch at 13:30 (potatoes in olive oil, 250g denis fish baked with butter, 0.7 of a lettuce/tomato/onion/mozzarella salad with homemade vinaigrette, plus baked onion and tomatoes), multivitamin and another double espresso at 16:00/16:05, and 350g honeydew melon at 16:30 (4 caffeine shots so far) — fish driving omega-3/selenium/vitamin D, tomatoes driving lycopene/vitamin C/folate, multivitamin topping off the rest.
